name: Single Back - Tight Left Wing Right - X Slant Pass Left
call: Single Back Tight Left Wing Right X Slant Pass Left

QB.rule: Two steps back, look at the X and throw it flat and early. The ball is gone before the rush gets home.

X.rule: Release straight off the line and run flat along it. Look the ball in — you are catching it on the move.

coaching_points: The X is the tight end on this side, so he releases off a defender's outside shoulder rather than off open grass. He has to get clean first.
The fullback and the wing both stay in. Five linemen and two backs on a two-step throw is more than anybody at this age gets through.
Call it after the Power has gone at this side twice. It is the one that punishes a linebacker for stepping up.
